prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin across all change types with only one test completed so far.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +0.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Postpone Account Sign In: Move the sign-in step to occur after pet selection so users build an emotional bond before creating an account. (why: Sign-in currently drops 27.1% of users early and has a long mean duration of 567s before users even choose a pet.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Walkthrough Screen: Introduce a dedicated interactive screen explaining desktop pet controls and key shortcuts right before completing onboarding. (why: Multiple support emails reported confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the desktop pet after setup.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Spawn Troubleshooting Status: Display progress indicators, time estimates, and desktop visibility troubleshooting tips on the waiting screen. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not showing up on the desktop, while waiting step median time is 201s.)
3: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Pet Generation Guidance: Provide clear photo quality guidelines and file format hints on the photo upload screen. (why: 3 support tickets noted custom pet creation failures or poor visually generated results.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Path Selection Step Counter & Clear Options: Update headline and body while enabling the step counter on the choose path screen to set clear expectations. (why: Choose path screen has a very high mean time of 514s despite a median of 8s, indicating hesitation.)
5: [finish, layout] Two-Column Home Intro Dashboard: Reorganize the home intro screen into a two-column dashboard layout presenting quick setup steps clearly. (why: Finish step drops 35.2% of users (64.8% completion) with a median duration of 395s.)
6: [home, notification] Background Notification When Pet is Ready: Enable background notifications on the waiting screen so users get alerted when their pet finishes loading. (why: Home waiting screen has an average wait time of 2336s, suggesting users switch away to other desktop apps.)

scores.note: Postponing sign-in reduces early friction where 27.1% of users drop off.
Directly addresses multiple support emails, but requires building a new screen.
Solves reported pet spawn issues and long median wait time on home step.
Low-cost guidance update targeting the largest step drop (39.1%) backed by support tickets.
Quick copy and counter change to address hesitation on initial path selection.
Redesign of finish layout to help reduce 35.2% drop-off rate.
Re-engages users during long 2336s mean waiting time via background alerts.
